spec.assertion: Structural: the S1 grant block's target is not 'allies' and, if it carries a count, count===1; behavioural: grants sharing an expiry frame number at most 2 (a team-wide encoding yields 4-5). Nearest-wrong = {kind:'allies'} (4-5x over-credit). The schema has NO random-target primitive, so whichever deterministic stand-in is used is a real over-credit vs a uniform draw — flagged, not asserted.

Every lily-sourced buffApply carries stat 'casterAtkPct' with a FLAT-resolved value >1000. Fails under the nearest-wrong stat choices atkPct (scales the target's own ATK) / highestAllyAtkPct, and under an encoding that leaks the raw kit percentage (20).

durationShots is undefined on every lily grant (seconds, not a round count — failure-mode 2), and the low-magnitude grant recurs >=2 times over 180 sec. Fails under a one-shot passive encoding (applies once at frame 0, then ~175 sec of zero uptime).

⚑ ALWAYS-FLAG field: the prose states no trigger, so trigger identity + first-fire phase are outside the input domain (datamined skill-cooldown / interval convention). Deliberately NOT asserted — an it.skip records it. Any cadence-specific assertion here would be a blind guess dressed as a spec.

Deleting the whole S2 slot leaves every unit's total byte-identical (totals record toEqual). Cover HP is not a modeled pool AND cover restoration is not unit-HP recovery, so the nearest-wrong is encoding it as a `heal` — that would emit recovery events and fire teammates' on-recovery triggers (crown is in the fixture), breaking this equality.

Unreachable at scope lock: the boss deals no damage and v1 has no cover/HP pool, so no ally's cover is ever destroyed. it.skip with the reason; its magnitude is instead pinned negatively by the 1:2 ratio test below.
No primitive: cover is not a modeled resource and the branch that carries it can never fire. it.skip.

The burst slot carries EXACTLY ONE casterAtkPct grant whose value is exactly 2x the S1 grant, and the emitted flat magnitudes form a 1:2 pair. GREEN only under the live no-destroyed-cover branch; RED under (a) modeling the 20% destroyed-cover branch instead (1:1 ratio) and RED under (b) modeling BOTH branches (two grants in the slot / two grants per cast). Backed behaviourally: halving the grant strictly lowers team damage.

Multiplying the burst grant's durationSec by 6 strictly increases team damage — proving the window is real and BOUNDED. RED under a permanent/windowless encoding (stretching an unbounded buff changes nothing) and under a durationShots (round-count) encoding.

Same random-target gap as S1; asserted only in its safe direction — repointing the block at {kind:'allies'} strictly raises team damage, so the shipped single-ally scoping is discriminated from the team-wide over-credit.

fixtures: controlComp('lily', true) for all six runs — liter B1 / crown B2 / lily / helm B3, so a burst chain actually completes (lily alone would cast nothing). Runs: (1) control; (2) lily fully silenced — derives her caster index by set-differencing buffApply casterIdx against control, and proves her kit is live at all; (3) burst grant retargeted to {kind:'allies'}; (4) burst grant durationSec x6; (5) burst grant value halved (the destroyed-cover branch magnitude); (6) S2 slot emptied. ⚠ FIXTURE HAZARD, reported not worked around: lily is Burst II and so is crown, so both compete for stage 2 and lily may never cast in this comp. The 'fixture exercises BOTH grants' test is an explicit guard — if it alone goes RED while the S1 tests stay green, the comp (not the model) is at fault and needs a Burst-II-free fixture. lily's caster index is derived at runtime, never hardcoded, because comp slot ordering is not part of the documented API.
gaps: it.skip burst branch 1 (cover destroyed) — unobservable: v1 has no cover/HP pool and the boss deals no damage, so the destroyed-cover branch can never fire at scope lock
it.skip Rebuild Cover with 30% HP — no primitive: cover is not a modeled resource

it.skip '1 random ally' — the effect schema has NO random-target kind; every available stand-in (alliesTopAtk/alliesLowestHp/self) is deterministic and over-credits relative to a uniform random draw across a 5-unit team. Modeling gap, reported not enacted

it.skip S1/burst trigger cadence — ⚑ the kit prose supplies no activation clause for S1, so trigger identity and first-fire phase come from the datamined skill-cooldown convention rather than the text; measurement-gated and deliberately unasserted

NOT ASSERTED (unobservable): whether the Cover-HP restore should fire teammates' `recovery` triggers. There is no heal/recovery event kind in the harness event list, so the claim is only reachable indirectly; it is pinned negatively by the S2-removal byte-identity test instead
